43 | def make_class_name(formal_name):
44 |     """Construct a valid class name from a formal name.
45 | 
46 |     :param formal_name: The formal name
47 |     :returns: The app's class name
48 |     """
49 |     # Identifiers (including class names) can be unicode.
50 |     # https://docs.python.org/3/reference/lexical_analysis.html#identifiers
51 |     xid_start = {
52 |         "Lu",  # uppercase letters
53 |         "Ll",  # lowercase letters
54 |         "Lt",  # titlecase letters
55 |         "Lm",  # modifier letters
56 |         "Lo",  # other letters
57 |         "Nl",  # letter numbers
58 |     }
59 |     xid_continue = xid_start.union(
60 |         {
61 |             "Mn",  # nonspacing marks
62 |             "Mc",  # spacing combining marks
63 |             "Nd",  # decimal number
64 |             "Pc",  # connector punctuations
65 |         }
66 |     )
67 | 
68 |     # Normalize to NFKC form, then remove any character that isn't
69 |     # in the allowed categories, or is the underscore character;
70 |     # Capitalize the resulting word.
71 |     class_name = "".join(
72 |         ch
73 |         for ch in unicodedata.normalize("NFKC", formal_name)
74 |         if unicodedata.category(ch) in xid_continue or ch in {"_"}
75 |     )
76 | 
77 |     # If the first character isn't in the 'start' character set,
78 |     # and it isn't already an underscore, prepend an underscore.
79 |     if (
80 |         class_name
81 |         and unicodedata.category(class_name[0]) not in xid_start
82 |         and class_name[0] != "_"
83 |     ):
84 |         class_name = f"_{class_name}"
85 | 
86 |     return class_name

53 |         "Ll",  # lowercase letters
